Our 3 highest-ticket-volume merchants (Cragsley, Marrowby, Studio Vrij) aren't getting harder questions or using slower channels - they simply have the most tickets per support agent in the company (up to 50 tickets/agent vs ~10-15 for a typical merchant), and it's spread across their whole team, not one struggling rep.

Urgent-priority tickets fail their resolution target everywhere, not just at our biggest merchants - several smaller merchants (e.g. Honeycomb Larder, 100% miss rate) do worse than Cragsley/Marrowby/Studio Vrij (63-67%), even though every merchant uses the same 8-hour target.
Good news: Studio Vrij's spring support meltdown has recovered - their average ticket resolution time dropped from 198 hours in the crisis month back to a healthy 16 hours by Q4.
